## 2026-07-15 [Fantasy Basketball Statistical Correlations & Why Turnovers Suck](videos/2026-07-15-0geFVzSqOnA.md)

- [5:43](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=343) Among last season's top 200, fantasy points per game (Yahoo default scoring) and usage correlate at R = 0.826, the strongest correlation found.
  > "is between fantasy points per game and usage. That's the strongest correlation with an R of 0.826."
- [6:45](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=405) Durant rank and minutes played correlate at 0.758.
  > "0.758. So, pretty high. The higher your minutes played, the higher your Durant ranking."
- [7:11](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=431) Durant rank and usage correlate at a stated 0.075. This is likely a slip for 0.75, since he calls it still pretty high.
  > "The fourth most high highest correlated was between Durant and usage at 0.075."
- [8:07](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=487) Points and assists have the highest positive correlation between categories at 0.613.
  > "Points and assists is the highest positive correlation at .613."
- [12:16](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=736) Rebounds and blocks correlate at 0.546.
  > "rebounds and blocks are up there. Third highest positive correlation at .546."
- [13:21](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=801) Points and threes correlate at 0.53. Points and FT% correlate at 0.445.
  > ".53 for points and threes, .445 for points and free throws."
- [15:24](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=924) Assists and turnovers correlate at 0.814, and points and turnovers at 0.778. These are the two strongest links between categories. He calls them negative because turnovers count against you.
  > "assists and turnovers. Negative 0.814. And points and turnovers? Negative 778."
- [16:46](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1006) Threes and FG% correlate at -0.655.
  > "It is hard to build a very high three-pointer team with very good field goal percentage. That is a negative .655."
- [20:02](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1202) FG% and FT% correlate at -0.512.
  > "field goal percentage and free throw percentage negatively correlated. -.512"
- [21:49](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1309) Points and blocks correlate at -0.001.
  > "Points and blocks -0.001 meaning if you get more points"
- [22:56](https://youtu.be/0geFVzSqOnA?t=1376) Rebounds and assists correlate at 0.056.
  > "Cuz that's one of the worst correlated categories, 0.056."
